value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step0.title: Welcome to Cavalry 🎉
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step0.body: This is the Viewport, where your designs come to life. Use it to preview and interact with your Compositions in real-time.
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step1.title: Scene Tree
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step1.body: Use the Scene Tree to select, rename, reorder and organise a Composition's Layers.
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step2.title: Attribute Editor
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step2.body: Use the Attribute Editor to fine-tune a Layer's properties – position, fill/stroke color, size and more.
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step3.title: Time Editor
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step3.body: Use the Time Editor to adjust animation timing and layer visibility.
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step4.title: Assets Window
value.onboarding.firstLaunch.step4.body: Use File > Import Assets... or double click in this window to import images, videos, fonts, audio files and more.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step0.title: Playback Controls
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step0.body: Use the Playback Controls to play and pause your animation. Use the buttons on the right to adjust various Viewport and Scene settings.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step1.title: Toolbar
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step1.body: The Toolbar contains all the drawing and selection tools. Alt/Option + click a primitive tool to instantly create a Shape at its default size.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step2.title: Tool Settings
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step2.body: Settings for the active tool will appear here.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step3.title: Shelf
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step3.body: The Shelf provides quick access to common features like the Duplicator, Align Behaviour and Layout Groups.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step4.title: Composition Settings
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step4.body: Click the button to open the Composition Settings window where you can adjust a Composition's Resolution, Frame Rate, Background Colour and more.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step5.title: Add Layers
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step5.body: Click the button to add Shapes, Behaviours, Effects and more to a Composition.
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step6.title: Project Settings
value.onboarding.uiDeepDive.step6.body: Keep Scenes, Assets and Palettes organised with Project Settings so Cavalry can manage file paths relative to your Project.
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step0.title: Set Keyframes
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step0.body: Click the diamond icon next to Position X to create a keyframe for this attribute.
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step1.title: Move the Playhead
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step1.body: Click near frame 50 in the Timeline to position the playhead.
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step2.title: Move Your Shape
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step2.body: Drag My Shape sideways to a new position on the right of the Viewport.
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step3.title: Add Some Bounce
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step3.body: Right-click on the first keyframe (at frame 0) and choose Magic Easing → Bounce Out.
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step4.title: Play it Back!
value.onboarding.animationBasics.step4.body: Hit Play to see your animation in action.

value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step0.title: Add a Behaviour
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step0.body: Right-click the Shape Position attribute and choose Add Behaviour → Noise.
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step1.title: Edit the Noise Behaviour
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step1.body: Double-click the Noise Behaviour in the Scene Tree to load its settings in the Attribute Editor.
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step2.title: Dial it Up
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step2.body: Increase the Strength value above 200% to make the noise effect more visible.
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step3.title: Add a Falloff
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step3.body: Switch to the Falloff tab, then click the Add Falloff button and choose Falloff.
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step4.title: Edit the Falloff
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step4.body: Double-click the Falloff in the Scene Tree to load its settings.
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step5.title: Set the Scale
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step5.body: Click and drag the Scale X attribute to 2.5 or higher. Hold Alt/Option to set both X and Y at the same time.
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step6.title: Play it Back!
value.onboarding.behaviourBasics.step6.body: Hit Play to see your procedural noise animation in action.

value.onboarding.nextGuide.connectionBasics.de: Learn how to connect attributes together.
value.onboarding.comp.connectionGuide.name: Connections Guide
value.onboarding.connectionBasics.step0.title: Create a Rectangle
value.onboarding.connectionBasics.step0.body: Hold Alt/Option and click the Rectangle tool to create a rectangle.
value.onboarding.connectionBasics.step1.title: Make a Connection
value.onboarding.connectionBasics.step1.body: Drag from the highlighted blue X label to the highlighted Rotation field to connect them.
value.onboarding.connectionBasics.step2.title: Adjust the Value
value.onboarding.connectionBasics.step2.body: Now click and drag in the Position X field. Notice the rectangle rotates as the value changes!
value.onboarding.nextGuide.renderBasics.label: Render an animation
value.onboarding.nextGuide.renderBasics.descri: Learn how to export your work
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step0.title: Exporting Still Images
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step0.body: For a quick export of a single frame, use File > Render Current Frame... to save a PNG.
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step1.title: Render Manager
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step1.body: To export a video or image sequence, use the Render Manager. Open it any time from File > Render Manager or press Alt/Option + B.
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step2.title: Add a Composition
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step2.body: Click + Current Composition to add your active composition to the render queue. Each item can be configured with its own format and output path.
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step3.title: Render
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step3.body: Click Render All to export. Cavalry supports PNG, JPEG, MP4, QuickTime, WebM and more.
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step4.title: Find Your Files
value.onboarding.renderBasics.step4.body: After rendering, click this arrow to reveal the output file in Finder/Explorer.
